title: SOM v0.3 skill.warning.raised payload (DRAFT 2, 2026-06-10)
description: Twelve-field SkillWarning per Skills Integration Spec v2 §4.4.2, ratified as the normative contract by decision #21. Severities are the permanent lower-case carve-out (decision #13). timestamp lives on the ENVELOPE (decision #18). instance_ref is RETIRED (decisions #3/#21) and hard-rejected — outputs scope to their firing level.

scope.description: The level the skill fired at — the link (destination-specific skills) or Delivery (system-level skills)

severity.description: Permanent lower-case carve-out (decision #13). hold: executor MUST withhold output on affected fields; flag: mark for review; inform: advisory

content_type.description: Governed render key added by decision #21 (e.g. sync.ai.banner); vendor-extended via extensions.com.{vendor}.*

message_type.description: Suffixed form per SOM-049; rides on the wire for topic routing
